translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Mak
book.title: MAK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Mak Tikak

content: Jiysis Bi Ñin Kalaw Gak Bap, Lotiw Ñin Ak Gek Suŋ Ayak
Ñin bap pen, Jiysis tip ak andkind Jiwda nan-gep korip ak amiy niŋak: bi ñin kalaw gak bap korip miŋgan kun ak ap mindek.
Bi Peresiy gok Jiysis yerip rek gek, Jiwda kanjsol miytiyŋ giy nup kor ginjun aŋgiy, kapkap niŋmindeyak.
Jiysis bi ñin kalaw gak anup aŋgak, “Tikjakiy, siŋbiy owan aŋgak.”

Aŋgek, nuk mindek siŋak apek, kuyip aŋgak, “Lotiw ñin chin ak yergep? Tep gep akaŋ timey gep? Biynimb gok kuyip simb niŋiy gon kim amniŋgiy akaŋ, kirgon kumniŋgiy?” Aŋgek, nup pen minim bap ma aŋgyak.

Biynimb minim nup ma dinjun aŋgiy niŋyak kun gok kuyip, niŋek nup mapin akak ak pen; gos tep ma niŋbay aŋgiy, kuyip simb niŋak. Kun ak kuyip niŋdand pandikiy, bi ñin kalaw gak ak nup, ñin parsek ayan aŋgek, parsek ayakniŋ suŋ ayak.
Kun gek niŋiy, bi Peresiy gok am Herot binuk mindeyak ak amiy, minim aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy, Jiysis nup kun kun giy ñaŋgjun aŋgyak.

Jiysis pen kuyip kirgiy, binuk gok diy, am Galiyliy chemb gol siŋak mindyakniŋ, biynimb kuŋaynep wiyak. Galiyliy biynimb gunap, Taya-Saydon biynimb gunap, Jerusalem biynimb gunap, Jiwdiya biynimb gunap, Yidumiya biynimb gunap, Joden ñiŋg pis tawakdoŋ ken biynimb gunap nuk giyiŋgip ar ak aŋgey niŋyak ak mey, nup niŋniŋg wiyak.
Pen nup diniŋon chinup suŋ ayniŋgamb aŋgiy, ap chichmiy yim gey apek, binuk gok kuyip aŋgek, bot bap di ayrep giyak.
Pen biynimb kichekiy malñiluk tap yerip ambaŋ ayak gok, Jiysis mindek siŋak koŋgim yimiy, minim yomb aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Nand Gor Ñinuk yimb aŋgyak!”
Jiysis pen, kichekiy malñiluk gok kuyip minim kilis aŋgiy aŋgak, “Minim kun ak miseŋ ma aŋgnimimb aŋgak.”
Jiysis Binuk Onep Wimiŋgan Ak Dak
Pen Jiysis miñmon taw bap amiy, binuk diniŋg gak gok aŋgek apeyak aŋgak,
“Yand nimbip bi onep wimiŋgan ak dispiyn ak mey, yand yip taŋgiy, bi minim yip dand amemb gok mindiy, aŋgyoken am biynimb okok kuyip aŋgñiniŋgambim.
Nimbip aspiyn ak mey, kichekiy malñiluk tap gok kunep aŋgyokniŋgambim aŋgak.”
Jiysis binuk dak kun gok yimb kiyk mey, bap Saymon, kisen Jiysis yimb nup bap Piyta aŋgak.

Bap Jemis, numam bap Jon, nop kiymiŋay yimb ak Sebediy. Jiysis kuyipmiŋay, timuk-bi aŋgak. Binuk bap Enjriw; bap Piyliyp; bap Batlomiyiw; bap Matyiw; bap Tomas; bap Jemis, nop nuk yimb ak Alpiyas. Bap Taydiyas, bap Saymon, nup Saymon Selot aŋgyak. Bap Jiwdas Yiskariyot. Nuk mey, kisen Jiysis nup mimuŋg gak.
Jiysis Nup Seytan Ambaŋ Ayip Aŋgyak
Pen Jiysis korip amek, tip ak biynimb kuŋaynep ap nan-gi mindyakniŋ, binuk gok yip tap ñiŋniŋgiy rek ma ayak.
Kun gek, biynimb gunap Jiysis sakiy ayip aŋgey niŋiy, nonim, nunay, numam sikop nup poŋdiniŋg wiyak.
Pen Jiwda low tiysa Jerusalem nimb wiyak gok aŋgyak, “Belsiybul Jiysis nup ambaŋ ayip rek, malñiluk tap gok aŋgyokip aŋgyak.” Nup yesek kun aŋgeyak,
nuk biynimb gok kuyip aŋgek apeyak, minim ar kun ak paydoŋ ay kuyip aŋgrep giy aŋgak, “Seytan yergiy Seytan nup aŋgyokniŋgamb?
Biynimb miñmon nokom bap kiyk keynep penpen giniŋgambay ak, wikan kun ak asik keykey ayniŋgambay. Pen amyoŋg apyoŋg gok kunep penpen giy, asik keykey ayniŋgambay.
Kun ak rek, Seytan nuk key kichekiy, malñiluk tap nuk gok ma aŋgyokniŋgamb.
“Bi kalrimey bap mindakniŋ, bi bap am, tap nup gok ma diniŋgamb; miñ di tiwniŋg ay nep mey, am tap nup gok diniŋgamb.
“Pen niŋrep ginimimb! Biynimb gok tap siy tap timey yerip yerip giniŋgambay ak, Gor nup aŋgniŋey, niŋiy kirginiŋgamb. Bapiy nup akaŋ yip aŋgjiwniŋgambay ak, kunep, kuyip niŋiy kirginiŋgamb ak pen,
Kawnan nuk ak nup aŋgjiwniŋgambay ak, niŋiy ma kirginiŋgamb. Miker kun ak perper mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Jiysis nup, Seytan yip mindip aŋgeyak mey; kun aŋgak.
Jiysis Nonim Numam Nuk Gok
Pen Jiysis nonim numam sikop ap mis akyaŋ mindyiŋg, nup “Owan” aŋgey,

biynimb korip miŋgan biyaŋ nup piŋiy kuskus gi mindeyak gok aŋgyak, “Nanim namam sikop ap mis biyaŋ mindiy, nip owan aspay aŋgyak.” Kun aŋgeyak, Jiysis biynimb mindeyak gok niŋdand pandikiy aŋgak, “Nimb mey amiy yand, mam yand gok mindpim. Biynimb Gor aŋgip rek niŋdipay gok mey, amiy, mam, ay yand gok rek mindpay aŋgak.”
